title: DeepSeek's Harness agent app hits 1.54 million daily users
summary: DeepSeek said its open-source agent app Harness, launched Aug 13, reached 1.54 million daily active users and processes about 92 trillion tokens a day, with ~35,000 user plugins; a plugin marketplace is planned.
reason: Fast mass adoption of autonomous agents in China expands agent use (F2 up); company-reported usage figures, T1.
